bull_case: Nu is reinvesting high-return equity into Brazil wallet share, Mexico/Colombia, credit and AI while sustaining 30%+ ROE. Per-share earnings are rising and dilution is negligible.
bear_case: Bank growth consumes regulatory equity. High reported ROE can reverse quickly if NPL/ECL rise, deposit costs increase or new geographies require more capital than expected.
thesis: RF is strong on a bank-adjusted basis. Q2 net income rose to $1.06B and ROE to 33% while equity expanded materially and shares stayed flat. A rough YoY incremental earnings-to-equity proxy is above 40%, well over the 9% required return. H1 buybacks consumed about 26% of H1 net income, implying high retained capital for growth. Because the harness's industrial capex/OCF runway metric is not valid for banks, runway is conservatively scored 75 rather than mechanically 90.

evidence.claim: Q2 2026 net income was $1.061B and ROE 33%, versus $637M and 28% in Q2 2025.

Quarter-end equity rose from about $9.575B in Q2 2025 to $13.252B in Q2 2026 while quarterly net income rose by about $424M; annualizing the incremental earnings against incremental equity gives a rough ~46% incremental return proxy.
evidence.source: Q2 2025/Q2 2026 Nu financial statements; analyst calculation

evidence.claim: H1 2026 net income was about $1.933B and share repurchases were $500.4M; absent dividends, roughly 74% of H1 earnings remained available to support capital growth before OCI/SBC effects.
Q2 net income per diluted share proxy rose from about $0.13 in Q2 2025 to $0.216 in Q2 2026 while diluted shares were essentially flat.
evidence.source: Q2 2025/Q2 2026 net income and diluted share counts; analyst calculation

evidence.claim: Risk-adjusted NIM improved to 12.4% in Q2, but 90+ NPL increased to 6.9%, so high growth returns remain exposed to credit-cycle seasoning.

counterevidence: Bank earnings require retained equity and cannot be treated as freely distributable FCF.
90+ NPL rose as Nu expanded into higher-risk segments.
Mexico and Colombia have not yet demonstrated full-cycle Brazil-like returns.
FX/OCI and regulatory capital rules make simple incremental-equity calculations noisy.
unknowns: Country-level normalized ROE after full bank conversion.
Long-run payout ratio consistent with target capital buffers.
Full-cycle loss-adjusted returns for newer risk cohorts.
falsifiers: ROE falls below the mid-20s without a compensating drop in capital intensity.
Per-share earnings stagnate while equity and RWA continue expanding rapidly.
Mexico/Colombia fail to generate returns above the cost of equity after scaling.

hard_veto_flags.rationale: Current incremental return proxies, ROE and risk-adjusted NIM remain well above the required-return hurdle; rising NPL is a monitor, not evidence of structural collapse.
Diluted shares are nearly flat YoY and the company is actively repurchasing shares.

key_kpis.name: ROE / incremental equity return
key_kpis.threshold: remain materially above cost of equity

key_kpis.name: Per-share net/distributable earnings
key_kpis.threshold: grow faster than diluted share count and required capital

subscores.rationale: A rough YoY incremental earnings-to-equity proxy is above 40%, while consolidated ROE is 33%. This is strong evidence of high returns at scale, discounted for FX/OCI and bank-capital measurement noise.

The industrial capex+R&D/OCF observable is not economically valid for banks. Using retained-capital absorption, geography and product runway instead, Nu retains most earnings while still earning 30%+ ROE; 75 is conservative because Mexico/Colombia are not fully seasoned.
Bank-adjusted owner-earnings/share proxy is compounding strongly: Q2 net income per diluted-share proxy rose about 66% YoY with negligible dilution and active buybacks.

uncertainties.rationale: Incremental equity return is an analytical proxy, not a company-reported metric, and is affected by FX/OCI.
The locked industrial observable is inapplicable to banking, requiring an explicitly disclosed economic substitution.
Reported net income is not fully distributable because regulatory capital must be retained.

dilution_metrics.rationale: Q2 net-income-per-diluted-share proxy increased roughly 66% YoY while diluted shares were essentially flat.
